text:
alina: Heads-up — SI partner (EdgeWorks) asked for full evidence bundle to complete their marketplace listing: SOC2 summary, the latest external pen-test report, vulnerability scan artifacts, and the vendor questionnaire answers. They want presigned links for ingest by Fri 2026-05-08.

sam: Got it. Do we have a canonical inventory of artifacts and owners?

maria: I have a partial list in GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/compliance-artifacts/blob/main/si-edgeworks-inventory.md — includes SOC2 attestations + older pen reports. Need to confirm redaction status.

ben: Important: external pen-test contains IPs/logs that must be redacted. Security needs to sign off before we share. @security-bot can you run a quick checklist for redaction requirements?

security-bot: Checklist run started. Items: (1) PII removal, (2) internal IP redaction, (3) contract + NDA check, (4) evidence access TTL. ETA 24h. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

alina: Thanks. For the presigned upload, EdgeWorks asked for an S3 bucket ingest with presigned POSTs (48h expiry). We need: a) a canonical ZIP per artifact type, b) per-file manifest, c) attestations for SOC2 control mappings.

jack: I can own the S3 presign flow and upload instructions. Plan: create a temp bucket `rw-evidence-edgeworks-<env>` with lifecycle 14 days. I will provide presign commands.

sam: Who will produce the control mapping doc (SOC2 control -> artifact)? That's what listing reviewers want to see.

maria: I can draft the mapping doc from the SOC2 coverage spreadsheet, but need @ben for annotations on test evidence.

ben: I'll add notes and flag anything that requires redaction. Expect my review by Tue EOD.

alina: Action items: 
- jack -> provision bucket + presigns, provide sample script (due Wed 2026-04-29)
- maria -> mapping doc draft (due Wed 2026-04-29)
- ben -> redaction review + approve artifacts (due Tue 2026-04-28)
- sam -> confirm SI questionnaire answers & signoff (due Thu 2026-04-30)

jack: sample presign snippet I plan to publish (feel free to copy):
```bash
aws s3api create-presigned-post --bucket rw-evidence-edgeworks-temp --key "soc2/%{filename}" --expires-in 172800
```

maria: Thanks — for manifest format I'm proposing CSV with columns: filename, artifact_type, owner, redacted(Y/N), source_doc_link. Good?

sam: Perfect. For the questionnaire, I'll re-run last year's answers and mark changes. Will ping legal if anything new pops up.

security-bot: Redaction checklist complete: PII none detected, internal IPs flagged in `pen-test/2025-12-pen.pdf` lines flagged: 412-428, 810-815. Recommend redaction before upload.

ben: I'll redact flagged ranges and add a short note in manifest explaining the redaction rationale.

alina: Quick question on evidence TTL — EdgeWorks needs access for their vendors for 7 days post-ingest but we should keep master copy for 1 year. jack, can lifecycle be 14 days on bucket but we push a copy to internal longterm archive after we close?

jack: Yes — lifecycle 14 days for the temp bucket. I'll add a job to copy to our internal S3://rw-compliance-archive with encryption and KMS tag after presign window closes.

maria: Should we include a short MD file with SOC2 scope summary (services in-scope, excluded modules) inside the ZIP? Reviewers always ask.

alina: Yes — add `scope_and_summary.md` to each ZIP. Also include a small manifest `attestations.json` listing versions and hashes.

sam: FYI — EdgeWorks also asked for contact point for follow-ups. I'll give them `compliance+marketplace@redwood.ai` and put ben as second contact.

ben: OK. I'll be on standby for any clarifications during their review window.

alina: Timeline recap: All artifacts packaged and presigned upload links shared with EdgeWorks by Fri 2026-05-08. Internal archive copy done by +7 days after.

jack: I'll create a short upload README and a small bash script to do multipart uploads. Will drop artifacts to the GH repo under /presign-scripts.

maria: I'll link mapping doc + scope file in the manifest and ping here when ready.

alina: Thanks team. If anything blocks the redaction step ping legal and tag me. :thumbsup:

security-bot: Event logged: evidence-handoff-edgeworks-1763501234. Assigned TTL and retention policies set for temp bucket.
